salvo: salvo14/mig/s6 (9 Nov 2026), lot k-alibaba. Multimodal Reranking Is a System One Decision (arXiv 2610.28435v1): Qwen3.8-27B "as released, with thinking disabled" used as a zero-shot reranker by reading the label logits of ONE forward pass (choice readout) or one yes/no question per candidate: a reranking measure through logits, not free generation. Research file: Table 2 choice hit@1. Added from the copy: the yes/no readout (Table 2), the two other columns of Table 3 and the latency of Table 4. JEV-27B-VL (LoRA adapter + decision head trained by others) is not converted; per-task Tables 7-12 not converted.
